candidateIdentity: Local ADS-002 candidate derived from the committed ADS-001 base; the coherent slice commit identity follows final verification and commit readback.
postconditions: One closed Effect command exposes only bootstrap, plan, replan and provider modes and has one BunRuntime.runMain entry point.
The command uses Config and Schema, a fixed git ls-files child process, the existing stage, plan-projection and provider-inventory owners, and closed safe error tags.
Bootstrap completion is recorded immediately after the CLI step with beta.64 and upstream commit provenance, the three allowed mutation-capable effects, and explicit not-observed state readback.
Preview and Production no longer repeat shasum identity blocks, plan/provider jq decoding and receipt construction, or TAXKIT_DOCS printf output blocks.
Workflow YAML still owns protected environments, permissions, exact non-cancellable locks, authority inputs, Alchemy and Wrangler execution, provider order and fail-closed shell control.
Provider JSON is decoded into existing inventory and bounded Wrangler Schemas; only sanitised Schema-encoded receipts and fixed output keys leave the command.

72 tests and 513 assertions, including every command mode, malformed input, safe tagged failures, deterministic output, secret-negative errors, workflow authority/order and static shell exclusions.

failedEvidence.failure: The first implementation did not scope the fixed git child process and attempted to decode an already Schema-decoded provider URL a second time.
failedEvidence.recovery: Scope the single runtime program, retain the existing decoded URL value, and rerun every command-mode test.
failedEvidence.result: Focused types passed and all six workflow-evidence tests passed.

failedEvidence.failure: Two pre-existing workflow contract expectations still required the retired shell hashing and projection runtime strings.
failedEvidence.recovery: Replace those assertions with the typed-owner contract and explicit negative checks for shasum, provider jq and TAXKIT_DOCS printf blocks.

failedEvidence.failure: Knip found three command-local Schemas, one command-local type and the identity calculator exported without a consumer.
failedEvidence.recovery: Keep those owners private to the command module, pass focused Knip and production Knip, then rerun the full graph.

documentationImpact.reason: These owners route bootstrap effects, workflow authority, typed evidence meaning, operator procedure, task state and bounded validation.
The native Website graph, Vite build owner, stage decoder, beta.64 parser, inventory meaning and immutable historical evidence remain unchanged.
The slice changes private workflow tooling, internal controls and maintainer documentation only; no version-managed package, public API, SDK export or public content changes.

limitations: The bootstrap receipt records allowed beta.64 effects and command completion, not which provider mutations occurred; its before/after state facts are explicitly not observed.
Static and local repository proof do not establish a hosted GitHub run, current Cloudflare state or hosted application behaviour.
nonClaims: No GitHub workflow was dispatched and no Cloudflare bootstrap, plan, deploy, rollback, destroy or provider readback was performed for ADS-002.
No Production, hosted application, DNS, custom-domain, package publication, release or public availability claim follows from this slice.
